table.description: Literal-pool float (stoich AFR 14.7), referenced by a mova in the fuel-correction/catalyst model (FUN_0003e560 in 60E15120_N3J1E, PID 0x3c path): diag_afr_word_a * fVar4 * 14.7. Converts lambda-domain fueling to AFR. NOT the base injection map (that is tbl 0x6ac88 + open-loop target 0x69e9c). Editing changes fuel correction + AFR display; this address is inside the app-flash checksum range (D3, 0x2000-0x7ffff) - bench-validate before flashing (AGENTS.md rule 10). See calibration_extraction_report.md 6a. FUEL CHANGE: for a fuel with a different stoich ratio set THIS scalar to the new stoich (e.g. 9.76 for E85) AND scale 'Scalar - Fuel Load Scale' by 14.7/new_stoich; leave the maps alone (they are lambda multipliers). For varying ethanol blends use the flex stoich table (0x6C444 in G-ROM_FLEX), not a fixed scalar. See data/definitions/README.md 'Literal-pool scalars'. ROM address 0x41a60, value 14.699999809265137 (asserted against ROM bytes by this script).

table.name: Scalar - Fuel Load Scale (literal pool)
table.description: Literal-pool float (0.07196): engine_load x 0.07196 -> fuel_load_scale_ffffbed0; the scalar every fuel-volume request scales by (0x306e8 in 60E15120_N3J1E). Physical units still candidate. Editing changes base fueling; address is inside the checksum range (D3) - bench-validate before flashing (rule 10). See calibration_extraction_report.md 6a. FUEL CHANGE: this is the scalar that changes OPEN-LOOP injected fuel volume (bed0 = load x 0.07196 in the 0x306e8 fuel-volume calc); for a different-stoich fuel scale it by 14.7/new_stoich (E85: x1.506 -> ~0.1084) and pair with setting 'Scalar - Stoich AFR' to the new stoich. Unit interpretation candidate - verify with a wideband that commanded AFR = new stoich at lambda=1.0 before driving. See data/definitions/README.md. ROM address 0x794ec, value 0.07196000218391418 (asserted against ROM bytes by this script).
